title: (USA) Director, Quality Assurance Continuous Improvement
text:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

We’re looking for a Director of Continuous Improvement to lead the monitoring, assurance, risk intelligence, control effectiveness, remediation, and transformation capabilities for Last Mile Delivery (LMD) Risk Operations. This role is responsible for helping the organization identify areas for improvement, why it is needed, whether risks and controls are effectively managed, and whether corrective actions actually solve the underlying problem. This leader will evolve traditional quality assurance into a broader, closed-loop assurance model that identifies systemic issues, determines root causes, drives accountable remediation, and validates effectiveness. The role will also lead the transformation of Risk Operations through process redesign, operational resilience, data-driven risk intelligence, automation, and AI—rethinking how work should operate rather than simply making existing manual processes faster. The continuous improvement org will have both tactical and strategic components to ensure end-to-end program evolution and growth.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

* **Lead the Monitoring & Assurance strategy** by evolving traditional transaction-level QA into a risk-based assurance capability that identifies recurring defects, systemic weaknesses, performance gaps, and emerging operational issues across Risk Operations.
* **Establish root cause and action management disciplines** that connect findings to underlying causes, accountable owners, remediation plans, target dates, escalation paths, and effectiveness validation—ensuring issues remain visible through sustainable closure.
* **Build the Risk Intelligence capability** by leveraging operational data, incidents, assurance findings, and other risk signals to identify patterns, trends, concentrations, benchmarks, and emerging risks and translate them into proactive recommendations for leadership.
* **Lead risk assessment and control effectiveness activities** to identify key operational risks, assess whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively, identify control gaps, and ensure deficiencies are addressed through accountable remediation.
* **Drive process improvement and operational transformation** by applying a TPM/engineering mindset to simplify, redesign, and standardize Risk Operations workflows, reducing unnecessary complexity, manual handoffs, failure points, and unclear ownership.
* **Strengthen operational resilience** by identifying critical processes, dependencies, single points of failure, technology and data vulnerabilities, and contingency needs to ensure critical Risk Operations capabilities can continue through disruption.
* **Lead AI transformation and automation strategy for Risk Operations** identifying opportunities to eliminate repetitive work while also reimagining how AI can reshape intake, investigations, monitoring, analysis, decision support, and reporting—not simply accelerate existing manual processes.
* **Establish reporting, dashboards, and management insights** that provide leadership with a consolidated view of operational health, emerging risks, control effectiveness, recurring issues, remediation status, and transformation progress.
